text:
Ethan (Finance Ops): Heads up — reseller SailPointX flagged that Azure marketplace charged new seats at full-month price even though they were provisioned mid-cycle. Partner says marketplace export has full quantity for period, not pro-rated. Need to reconcile and propose credit.

Rashmi (Partner Ops): Can you paste the marketplace CSV rows? I want to see the timing and SKU. If it's a marketplace-side export bug we escalate to Azure partner billing.

Ethan (Finance Ops): CSV extract below (period 2024-09-01 to 2024-09-30):

```
subscription_id,sku,seat_count,unit_price,report_date
sub_sail01,azure-team-seat,200,12.00,2024-09-01
sub_sail01,azure-team-seat,280,12.00,2024-09-20
```

Customer added 80 seats on 2024-09-20. Marketplace exported second row as full 280 seats charged for the whole period instead of charging 80 seats pro-rated for 10 days. Gross overcharge estimate = 80 seats * 12.00 * (10/30) = $320.

Gabe (Revenue Ops): So gross refund ~ $320. Tax? If reseller is EU, VAT could change net amounts. Also, partner commission and marketplace withholding need handling. Contract: reseller commission 18% of net; marketplace withholds 10% on refunds.

Lena (Accounting): For anything >$2k we need Director approval and a GL impact memo. This is <$2k so standard credit memo flow is fine, but include tax code and settlement id. We'll need original invoice ref and the Azure settlement run.

Billing Bot: Created ticket FIN-4977: "Azure prorate misreport - SailPointX". Assigned to @lena and @rashmi.

Rashmi (Partner Ops): I'll open a case with Azure Partner Billing — this looks like their export flattened incremental rows. If Azure confirms, they'll issue an amended settlement. Meanwhile we should prepare a provisional credit memo to the reseller to keep CS happy; mark as "pending reclaim" in Netsuite.

Ethan (Finance Ops): Agreed. Drafting credit memo: amount $320 gross. Withholding: 10% marketplace = $32 withheld; net payable $288. Commission reversal: 18% of gross $57.60 should be reversed from commission accruals. Should we include a separate VAT adjustment line?

Lena (Accounting): Yes include VAT line if reseller shows VAT on the original invoice. Ask partner for VAT flag. For the JE: 1) Reverse revenue $320 DR Sales; 2) Reverse commission accrual $57.60 CR Commission Expense; 3) Record marketplace withholding payable $32 CR; 4) VAT adjustment as needed. Add original invoice id: INV-20240930-SAIL. Also attach marketplace export to audit.

Gabe (Revenue Ops): Sounds good. @Oliver can you approve provisional credit memo flow? We want to issue now pending Azure confirmation to avoid customer escalation.

Oliver (Revenue Director): Approve provisional credit memo up to $500 for customer-facing remedy provided we mark it provisional and include reclaim clause if Azure reimburses us. CC accounting@redwood.com when you post.

Rashmi (Partner Ops): Noted. Opening Azure case now, case id AZ-CASE-21188. I'll request amended settlement and CSV.

Billing Bot: Updated FIN-4977 status -> "provisional credit issued". Documented provisional credit memo id CM-1787-P.

Ethan (Finance Ops): Posting provisional credit in Netsuite as CM-1787-P and tagging FIN-4977. Will include note: "Provisional credit pending Azure settlement adjustment; reclaim if Azure reimburses within 60 days."

Lena (Accounting): When posting include memo lines and attach marketplace CSV + Azure case link. I'll take it for posting and the JE.

Rashmi (Partner Ops): Will follow up with partner for VAT flag and ask for signed acceptance for the provisional credit.

Ethan (Finance Ops): Thanks. I'll update FIN-4977 once Azure responds. :white_check_mark:
